name: Farmer Bren
text: Ugh… I can hardly lift my tools, my body feels drained.

name: Farmer Bren
text: Back when I was stronger, I’d mix the golden eggs from the caves with those bright yellow berries from the forest.

name: Farmer Bren
text: That golden mixture always filled me with energy.

name: Farmer Bren
text: I could really use something like that again.
